name: grey_diplo Grey_DIS_is_active Fix
short_description: Grey's Diplomatic Interaction Suite declares its own CMF registry flag (Grey_DIS_is_active) bare instead of REPLACE_OR_CREATE:, so CMF's own 'always = no' default silently wins and the flag never reads yes for other mods that check it. This overrides it correctly. Internal to grey_diplo; load anywhere after it.
